long_biography.plain_text:
Galsgaard entered business through Wheat, the Danish children's clothing company he co-founded with Charlotte Galsgaard in 2002. The brand developed internationally while preserving family ownership, with Peter active in management and later serving on its board. His full registered name, Peter Julius Nemeth Galsgaard, also appears in the management of D1 Holding, the family vehicle connected to Wheat.

His maritime interest predates the company. He served in the Danish merchant navy and crossed the Atlantic four times aboard the training ship Danmark. In 2018, Peter and Charlotte joined French marine carpenter Yann Martinie de Maisonneuve to create Pacific High in Indonesia. The business combines traditional phinisi construction, crewed expeditions and destination planning across the Indonesian archipelago.
